author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before had a solid dot ball floating away from the figure, a flat arm bar and a teardrop pin with an inner stroke (read as a vase/flame); redrawn with the figure in the reference's delivery stride: head 8 above a short neck, torso leaning to the hip, ball arm swung back holding the ball behind, back leg extended and front leg bent, and a tall pin with round head, neck and belly ahead.
omissions: Forward-reaching arm omitted (it cannot keep 8 from both the head and the tall pin); figure drawn as a stick figure rather than the reference's outlined limbs.
